title: Sean ‘Diddy’ Combs addresses court after prosecution and defense spar over sentencing – live updates
summary: Combs, whose children described him as a ‘changed man’, addresses judge in sentencing hearing in New York The prosecution submitted several victim impact statements to the court ahead of sentencing, including one from Ventura. “While the jury did not seem to understand or believe that I engaged in freak-offs because of the force and coercion the defendant used against me, I know that is the truth, and his sentence should reflect the reality of the evidence and my lived experience as a victim” Ventura wrote .
